meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 shadcn 组件和项目，添加、搜索、修复、调试和组合 UI
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 shadcn/ui 构建 React 界面，需要管理组件和项目配置
copy.tagline_en: Manage shadcn components and projects: add, search, fix, debug, and compose UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build React UIs with shadcn/ui and need to manage components and project config

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读取项目的 shadcn/ui 配置与已装组件,帮你添加、搜索、修复、调试、样式化和组装 UI 组件(含聊天界面),并给出组件文档、用法示例和对应的 CLI 命令。
howto.when: 当处理 shadcn/ui 项目、组件注册表或预设(--preset)代码时触发;也响应相关初始化/切换命令。

say.text: 给项目添加一个 Dialog 组件
say.note: Claude 会检查是否已安装,再用 CLI 添加。

say.text: 帮我把这个表单改成 shadcn 规范的 FieldGroup 结构
say.note: Claude 会按规则重构并检查错误。

say.text: 把当前项目切换到另一个预设
say.note: Claude 会先询问覆盖/合并方式,再执行。

howto.what_en: Claude reads the project's shadcn/ui config and installed components, then helps add, search, fix, debug, style, and compose UI components (including chat), and provides docs, examples, and CLI commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when working with shadcn/ui projects, component registries, or preset (--preset) codes, and for related init/switch commands.

say_en.text: Add a Dialog component to the project.
say_en.note: Claude checks if installed, then adds via CLI.

say_en.text: Refactor this form to the shadcn FieldGroup pattern.
say_en.note: Claude rewrites per rules and checks errors.

say_en.text: Switch this project to another preset.
say_en.note: Claude asks how to overwrite/merge, then applies.
